HOSTING_IDLE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the idle dimension, hosting.idle.*: what libomx-clap-core answers about its hold of the CPU idle states (/dev/cpu_dma_latency) while a plugin is active. The dimension is this library's: the hold lives in it, for every host that links it (#296).

oneOf.title: idleHoldRefused
oneOf.description: The CPU idle-latency device could not be opened for writing, so the host runs with no hold on it. Grant write access to /dev/cpu_dma_latency, or accept that idle states are not held.

HOSTING_WINDOW_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the window dimension, hosting.window.*: why omx-clap-host refuses to show a plugin's own window (clap.gui) when show_external_ui asks for it (#180). The dimension is the standalone host's: the console never shows a plugin's native window.

oneOf.title: windowNoDisplay
oneOf.description: There is no display to show the window on: none was named, or its server refused the connection. The plugin keeps running without a window.

oneOf.title: windowUnsupported
oneOf.description: This plugin has no window, or none in a form this host can show, embedded or floating. Run it without a window.

oneOf.title: windowRefused
oneOf.description: The plugin refused to create, embed or show its own window when asked. Run it without a window.

HOSTING_CLAP_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the clap dimension: hosting.clap.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: clapExtensionsNotCovered
oneOf.description: Not every extension this plugin declares is covered by what was checked. Check the plugin against the extensions this host covers, or accept the gap.

oneOf.title: clapFormatNotHosted
oneOf.description: This host does not host the CLAP format. Use a host that does.

oneOf.title: clapHeadlessFailed
oneOf.description: The plugin failed while being checked headless, with no window. Fix what failed and check it again.

oneOf.title: clapLatencyMismatch
oneOf.description: The plugin’s reported latency does not match what was measured. Trust the measured figure, not the plugin’s own report.

oneOf.title: clapNoteInput
oneOf.description: This configuration refuses the note input the plugin declares. Run the plugin in a configuration that accepts its note input, or without notes.

oneOf.title: clapProcessError
oneOf.description: The plugin’s processing call returned an error. Treat the plugin as faulty for this block.

oneOf.title: clapThreadViolation
oneOf.description: The plugin called back from the wrong thread. Treat the plugin as not thread-safe.

oneOf.title: clapUnqualified
oneOf.description: This plugin has not been qualified for hosting. Qualify it before relying on it.

HOSTING_COST_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the cost dimension: hosting.cost.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: costAboveCeiling
oneOf.description: The plugin’s measured CPU cost is above the ceiling for this rate and quantum. Raise the ceiling, or use a plugin that costs less.

oneOf.title: costFieldsMissing
oneOf.description: The cost measurement is missing fields it needs. Measure the plugin’s cost again, completely.

oneOf.title: costSpiky
oneOf.description: The plugin’s CPU cost has a spiky tail: occasional blocks cost much more than the rest. Treat it as unreliable at this rate and quantum.

oneOf.title: costUnmeasured
oneOf.description: The plugin’s CPU cost has not been measured at this rate and quantum. Measure it before relying on a ceiling.

oneOf.title: costWithinCeiling
oneOf.description: The plugin’s measured CPU cost is within the ceiling for this rate and quantum.

HOSTING_FEATURES_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the features dimension: hosting.features.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: featuresAtomInUnfed
oneOf.description: This plugin declares a non-MIDI atom input that nothing here can feed. Run it where that input can be fed, or accept it stays empty.

oneOf.title: featuresDisqualifying
oneOf.description: This plugin needs a host feature this host does not provide. Run it on a host that provides that feature.

oneOf.title: featuresMidiIn
oneOf.description: This plugin’s MIDI input is fed nothing. Connect a source of MIDI, or accept it runs with none.

oneOf.title: featuresMissing
oneOf.description: This plugin is missing a feature it needs to run here. Provide that feature, or run it elsewhere.

oneOf.title: featuresPortsUnreadable
oneOf.description: This plugin declares ports its reader cannot read, so none of them reach the host. The fault is in the plugin’s own bundle, not in this host.

oneOf.title: featuresProvided
oneOf.description: This plugin has every feature it needs.

oneOf.title: featuresUnscanned
oneOf.description: This plugin was scanned before this field existed, so it was never checked for it. Scan it again to check.

HOSTING_LATENCY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the latency dimension: hosting.latency.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: latencyNonconforming
oneOf.description: This plugin’s reported latency does not conform to what a host can use. Don’t trust its reported latency.

oneOf.title: latencyParameterDependent
oneOf.description: This plugin’s latency changes with its parameters. Re-read its latency after a parameter change that could affect it.

oneOf.title: latencyResolved
oneOf.description: This plugin’s latency has been resolved to a fixed figure.

oneOf.title: latencyUnmeasured
oneOf.description: This plugin’s latency has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

HOSTING_MEMORY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the memory dimension: hosting.memory.*, what a qualifier, a host or the console read of a plugin's measured memory against a host's budget, by code, never by prose.

oneOf.title: memoryAboveCeiling
oneOf.description: This plugin’s measured memory is above the host’s budget. Raise the budget, or use a plugin that uses less memory.

oneOf.title: memoryUnmeasured
oneOf.description: This plugin’s memory has not been measured at the host’s rate and quantum, so it is not known to fit. Measure it before trusting that it fits.

oneOf.title: memoryWithinCeiling
oneOf.description: This plugin’s measured memory fits a budget that was itself measured on this kind of host.

oneOf.title: memoryWithinProvisionalCeiling
oneOf.description: This plugin’s measured memory is under a budget that has not yet been measured on this kind of host. This is not a guarantee that it fits, only that it is under that provisional budget.

HOSTING_OUTPUT_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the output dimension: hosting.output.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: outputNonFinite
oneOf.description: This plugin produced non-finite output: infinities or NaNs. Treat its output as a fault.

HOSTING_OVERRIDE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the override dimension: hosting.override.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: overrideIsolated
oneOf.description: The curator’s override is isolated from this run. Apply the override where the curator’s run can see it.

HOSTING_PATCH_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the patch dimension: hosting.patch.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: patchBusy
oneOf.description: The plugin’s patch is busy right now. Try again once it’s free.

oneOf.title: patchNotWritable
oneOf.description: This plugin’s patch cannot be written. Treat it as read-only.

oneOf.title: patchTooLarge
oneOf.description: This patch is too large for the plugin to accept. Use a smaller patch.

HOSTING_PRESET_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the preset dimension: hosting.preset.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: presetNotFound
oneOf.description: This preset could not be found. Check its name and location and try again.

HOSTING_PROVENANCE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the provenance dimension: hosting.provenance.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: hostProvenanceDiffers
oneOf.description: The host that measured this plugin differs from the one running it now. Measure it again on this host, or accept the difference.

oneOf.title: sweepControlDidNotFire
oneOf.description: The sweep’s control plugin did not fire during the measurement. Check the control plugin and measure again.

HOSTING_REALISED_CODES.description: What the console did with a plugin's verdict: hosting.realised.* and the outcomes with no dimension (hosting.disabled, hosting.unjudged, hosting.no-realisation, hosting.linked), read by code, never by prose.

oneOf.title: disabled
oneOf.description: This plugin is disabled. Enable it before using it.

oneOf.title: linked
oneOf.description: This plugin is realised linked into the host’s own process.

oneOf.title: noRealisation
oneOf.description: This plugin has no realisation: nothing runs it. Give it a way to run before using it.

oneOf.title: realisedInProcess
oneOf.description: This plugin is realised in its own process, isolated from the host’s.

oneOf.title: unjudged
oneOf.description: This plugin has not been judged yet. Judge it before trusting any verdict about it.

HOSTING_RESOURCE_HINTS_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the resource-hints dimension: hosting.resource-hints.*, why the host refuses the hints a plugin declares about itself (omx-contract's RESOURCE_HINTS, through the CLAP draft org.openmixer.resource-hints.draft/0 or the omxres LV2 properties). A refused declaration is trusted for none of its hints: every hint reads as unknown.

oneOf.title: resourceHintsOutOfRange
oneOf.description: This plugin declared a resource hint figure below zero, or past what that hint can hold. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.

oneOf.title: resourceHintsUnknownHint
oneOf.description: This plugin’s declared hints set a bit that names no known hint. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.

oneOf.title: resourceHintsWrongUnit
oneOf.description: This plugin declared a resource hint figure in the wrong unit: a flag that is not a boolean, or a count, time or size that is not a whole number. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.

HOSTING_RT_SAFETY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the rt-safety dimension: hosting.rt-safety.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: rtSafetyClean
oneOf.description: The plugin showed no real-time safety violation under the sweep. It passed clean.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotReproducible
oneOf.description: The real-time safety measurement could not be reproduced. Measure it again before trusting it.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotesClean
oneOf.description: The plugin showed no real-time safety violation while playing notes. It passed clean.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotesUnmeasured
oneOf.description: The plugin’s real-time safety while playing notes has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotesViolations
oneOf.description: The plugin violated real-time safety while playing notes. Treat it as not real-time safe with notes.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyOwnThreads
oneOf.description: The plugin starts threads of its own beside its audio. It is real-time safe, and it can share a worker; its threads share the cores with the audio.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyUnmeasured
oneOf.description: The plugin’s real-time safety has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyViolations
oneOf.description: The plugin violated real-time safety during the run. Treat it as not real-time safe.

HOSTING_STABILITY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the stability dimension: hosting.stability.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: stabilityBelowFloor
oneOf.description: The plugin was soaked for fewer cycles than the floor needs. Soak it for enough cycles before trusting the result.

oneOf.title: stabilityCrashUnattributed
oneOf.description: Something crashed during the run, but not a plugin that could be identified. Narrow down which plugin crashed before trusting any of them.

oneOf.title: stabilityCrashedAttributed
oneOf.description: This plugin crashed during the run. Don’t host it until it’s fixed.

oneOf.title: stabilityCalleeSavedClobbered
oneOf.description: This plugin returned from a call having changed a register it should have preserved. The host put the register back, but other plugins sharing its process were not protected, so it now runs only in a worker of its own.

oneOf.title: stabilityCrashedLive
oneOf.description: This plugin crashed live on this rig. Don’t host it on this rig until it’s fixed.

oneOf.title: stabilityLinksGuiToolkit
oneOf.description: This plugin links a GUI toolkit, which this host does not run headless. Run it where a GUI toolkit is safe, or use a plugin without one.

oneOf.title: stabilitySoakFailedAtRate
oneOf.description: The plugin failed its soak test at this sample rate. Don’t trust it at this rate until it’s fixed.

oneOf.title: stabilitySoaked
oneOf.description: The plugin completed its soak test. It held up over the run.

oneOf.title: stabilitySpawnsThreads
oneOf.description: This plugin spawns its own threads. Watch it for behaviour a host does not control.

oneOf.title: stabilityUnmeasured
oneOf.description: This plugin’s stability has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

oneOf.title: stabilityUnsoaked
oneOf.description: This plugin has not been soaked. Soak it before trusting it over a long run.

HOSTING_STATE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the state dimension: hosting.state.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: stateNotACopy
oneOf.description: This path is not a save’s copy directory of the state root. Use the copy directory a save actually made.

oneOf.title: statePathOnAudio
oneOf.description: This path was requested from the audio role, where it cannot be made. Request it from outside the audio role.

oneOf.title: statePathOutside
oneOf.description: This path is empty, absolute, or steps outside with a `..` component. Use a path relative to the state root, with no `..`.

oneOf.title: statePathSymlink
oneOf.description: A component of this path is a symbolic link, which is not allowed here. Use a path with no symbolic links.

oneOf.title: statePathTooLong
oneOf.description: This path, or one of its components, is too long. Use a shorter path.

oneOf.title: statePathUnmakeable
oneOf.description: The directory for this path could not be made. Check that the state root is writable and try again.

oneOf.title: stateUnreadable
oneOf.description: This plugin’s saved state could not be read. Treat it as lost, or restore it from a working copy.

HOSTING_TOPOLOGY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the topology dimension: hosting.topology.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: topologyAmbisonicConfig
oneOf.description: This plugin’s ambisonic port refuses the carrier’s channel ordering or normalisation. Use a carrier whose ordering and normalisation this port accepts.

oneOf.title: topologyChannelMapUnknown
oneOf.description: This plugin’s surround port names a channel this host does not know, or refuses the carrier’s channel mask. Use a carrier whose channels this host recognises.

oneOf.title: topologyInstrument
oneOf.description: This plugin is hosted as an instrument: it has no audio input of its own.

oneOf.title: topologyMatched
oneOf.description: This plugin’s ports match the topology it is hosted on.

oneOf.title: topologyNoAudioInput
oneOf.description: This plugin has no audio input.

oneOf.title: topologyNoAudioOutput
oneOf.description: This plugin has nothing for the host to carry on its output: it declares an audio input or auxiliary port but no main output. Use a plugin with a main audio output, or run it as a pass-through tool.

oneOf.title: topologyPortTooWide
oneOf.description: This plugin’s port has more channels than the limit, or its ambisonic channel count is not valid for its order. Use a plugin whose ports stay within the channel limit.

oneOf.title: topologyPortWithoutChannels
oneOf.description: This plugin declares a port with zero channels. Fix the plugin’s port declaration before hosting it.

oneOf.title: topologyTooManyPorts
oneOf.description: This plugin declares more auxiliary ports than the limit on one side, or more than one main port on a side. Use a plugin within the port limits.

oneOf.title: topologyWiderThanStrip
oneOf.description: This plugin’s main port is wider than the strip it runs on. Run it on a strip wide enough for its main port.

HOSTING_WORKER_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the worker dimension: hosting.worker.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: workerNonconforming
oneOf.description: This plugin’s worker does not conform to what a worker must do. Don’t rely on its worker.
